findings.evidenceJa: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります
findings.governingReading: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります offers return only if he tells her to, while begging him to stop before Shirou.
findings.explanation: Conditional obedience to a return order becomes an unconditional promise to come home.

findings.highlight: The fever appears to have worsened, though the rest of her body doesn't feel any warmer.
findings.evidenceJa: 顔は熱で上気したままだったが、熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそうだ
findings.governingReading: 顔は熱で上気したまま and 熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそう distinguish continuing facial flush from apparent fever degree.
findings.explanation: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.

findings.highlight: make okayu and something to accompany it.
findings.evidenceJa: 朝のお粥のお返しを作らないといけない
findings.governingReading: After putting the feverish Sakura to bed, Shirou must make something in return for the morning porridge.
findings.explanation: Shirou's meal as repayment for the morning porridge becomes porridge with an accompaniment, removing the stated return of care.
